# Project Phoenix Status Report

## Budget
The approved budget for Project Phoenix is 250,000 dollars. By the end of the third quarter, 180,000 dollars had been spent, mostly on contractor fees and cloud hosting.

## Timeline
The project runs for six months. The beta release is scheduled for 14 March and general availability for 30 June. The security review is the main schedule risk.

## Team
The core team has eight people: three backend engineers, two designers, one product manager, one QA engineer and one DevOps engineer.

## Risks
Key risks are a delayed security review, dependency on a single payment provider and limited QA capacity during the beta.
